query: INSERT INTO semantic_products(tenant,product_id,revision,embedding,embedding_model,content_hash) SELECT tenant,id,revision,$3,$4,$5 FROM products WHERE tenant=$1 AND id=$2 AND name||E'\n'||category||E'\n'||description=$6 ON CONFLICT(tenant,product_id) DO UPDATE SET revision=EXCLUDED.revision,embedding=EXCLUDED.embedding,embedding_model=EXCLUDED.embedding_model,content_hash=EXCLUDED.content_hash,updated_at=now()
